journey.name: grant signup existing identity
journey.description: Verifies that grant signup reuses an existing Pubky identity. Precondition: an isolated unlocked wallet with Paykit enabled and an active locally managed Pubky identity. Record its public key and profile name. A controlled requesting app supplies a fresh signup_grant URL for that identity's homeserver, a reachable relay, and ordinary app permissions without a Bitkit companion claim.

actions.action: Open the prepared signup_grant URL in Bitkit
Verify the authorization sheet shows the recorded requesting app and permissions
Tap Authorize (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") and complete PIN or biometric approval when enabled
Verify the existing authorization success state is shown (id "PubkyAuthOK")
Verify Create Profile is not opened
Verify the profile public key and name match the recorded identity
Verify the requesting app receives approval from the recorded public key
